note: Kho block. Agent KHONG chon block bang cach doc ten - no khai narrativeFunction x visualLanguage o buoc 2a/2b (viec no da bat buoc phai lam), roi tra `fits` de ra danh sach hop le. Truong `whenNotToUse` quan trong ngang `whenToUse`: no la thu chan viec chon cho co, cho du. Xem block_gate.py.

calibration.why: Block usage and arrangement counts are implementation signals, not acceptance quotas. Review repetition on rendered contact sheets with sheet_vision.

blocks.purpose: Mot khung anh toan man + MOT loi khang dinh dat len tren.
blocks.whenToUse: Khi canh can khong khi, dia diem, mot khoanh khac - thu nguoi xem chi phai NHIN, khong phai doc. Nam canh hat giong deu duoc khen cung mot ly do: 'an tuong', 'tao duoc khoang lang, khoang nghi'. Day la block dung de dieu tiet nhip cho ca video, khong phai de giai thich.
blocks.whenNotToUse: KHONG dung khi canh phai giai thich mot co che, mot con so, hay mot quan he. Anh nen + chu la cach de nhat de lam day khung hinh va cung la cach de nhat de khong noi gi - do dung la khuyet tat visual-language.md sinh ra de chan. Neu `visualTransformation` cua canh khong the viet ra thanh mot quan he, thi van de nam o buoc 2a chu khong phai o day.
fixedFromSeed: S26 punch chi hien 21f = 0,7s cho bon chu; block kep ve toi thieu 48f.
S22 nam o drift .07, giua hai nac cua ban dau - da them nac `calm`.

blocks.purpose: Ban do that + ghim dia diem + mot loi khang dinh.
blocks.whenToUse: Khi canh noi ve MOT NOI CU THE va nguoi xem can biet no o dau, rong bao nhieu, nam trong cai gi. `areaKm2` ve vong dien tich that - dung no khi con so dien tich la thu dang noi, dung de narration doc con so mot minh.
blocks.whenNotToUse: KHONG dung cho mot dia diem chi duoc nhac thoang qua - mot ban do chiem tron khung hinh la mot loi hua rang cho nay quan trong. Va tuyet doi KHONG dung `MapLocationScene` trong SceneTemplates.jsx thay cho block nay: no ve mot cai ghim tren giay trang, khong co ban do nao ben duoi.

requires.tilesCached: cache_map_tiles.py phai chay TRUOC. Mot ban do hong tile van render THANH CONG voi mot lo thung, vi MapGraphic nha delayRender theo han gio.

blocks.purpose: Truc thoi gian hai moc + khoang cach giua chung duoc goi ten.
blocks.whenToUse: Khi hai thoi diem duoc dat canh nhau va KHOANG GIUA chung moi la y nghia. Bat `span` khi con so khoang cach la thu dang noi ('8 NAM'); de trong khi narration da noi ro roi.
blocks.whenNotToUse: KHONG dung cho mot chuoi su kien dai - truc hai moc la de so sanh, khong phai de liet ke. KHONG dung khi thu can thay la NGUYEN NHAN chu khong phai thoi diem.
blocks.coverage: S25 chi duoc phu NUA DAU: ban goc con chong them mot ban do vao frame 111. Canh nao can ban do chong len truc thoi gian thi viet bespoke - slot ban do moi 1 lan dung, chua du can cu.
fixedFromSeed: S8 ve DimensionLine o 42px, duoi san 44px cua text_gate. Block dung 44.

blocks.purpose: Mot tai lieu / hien vat dat giua khung, duoc chu y vao.
blocks.whenToUse: Khi bang chung la mot VAT THE co that - mot trang ho so, mot tam bien, mot con dau. Bat `reticle` khi viec can thay la 'soi vao day'; dung `gloss` khi vat the can duoc dich nghia ra.
blocks.whenNotToUse: KHONG dung khi tai lieu chi la minh hoa chung chung cho 'giay to' - mot to giay khong ten tuoi minh hoa cho pham tru, khong minh hoa cho su viec, va no doc ra la anh kho. Anh phai la tai lieu THAT cua chinh cau chuyen.

blocks.purpose: Khung ket: dien thoai + nut theo doi + cu cham thich.
blocks.whenToUse: Canh cuoi cung cua video, va chi canh do.
blocks.whenNotToUse: Khong dung o bat cu cho nao khac trong video.
blocks.exception: Block DUY NHAT khong thoa quy tac '>=2 canh moi dong goi'. No vao kho vi mot ly do khac han, khong phai vi duoc noi: no tai dung THEO CAU TAO chu khong theo bang chung - moi video deu ket bang loi keu goi theo doi voi noi dung gan nhu khong doi. Cac block khac phai chung minh hinh hoc cua chung chuyen duoc sang noi dung khac; block nay khong co 'noi dung khac' de chuyen sang. DUNG dung lap luan nay de dong goi mot canh minh hoa 1 lan dung.
